blocks.x: Did what people like Kenny Clark and Max

No, they didn't influence me, but I like what they were doing, you know, because when I first heard Max really drop those bombs and things like that was with Dizzy's big band, and he sound very good in that band. When I heard Kenny Clark he was with MJQ, he sound very good because they were organized. I knew that I wouldn't be able to do it. I could do those beats that they were doing, but I couldn't feel them like they were doing. So it never occurred to me that, it didn't bother me any because there's room for all kind of styles out here today.
